visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A black Mercedes G-Class SUV performs aggressive off-road maneuvers on a flat, sandy dirt field. The vehicle kicks up large, thick plumes of light-colored dust as it drifts and spins. The lighting is overcast and flat, with no clear shadows. No individuals are visible outside the car. (2) A horizontal split-screen appears: the top half shows a man in a black Mercedes cap and denim shirt gesturing with both hands while speaking; the bottom half shows a young woman with short hair sitting in a car seat looking straight ahead. A white text graphic "老闆畫餅中..." is centered. (3) A close-up shot features a hand holding a smartphone, capturing a photo of the woman who is now smiling broadly through the car's open window. A second man with a professional camera is partially visible in the background. (4) The man in the black cap is seen in a medium close-up from the driver's seat of the car. He speaks directly to the camera, using varied hand gestures to emphasize his points. The leather interior and high-tech dashboard are clearly visible. (5) A tight close-up focuses on two orange and white towels with black stylized text, laid out on a red textured surface, likely the hood or roof of the SUV. (6) The man continues his monologue from the driver's seat, appearing reflective and sincere. The video concludes with a dark semi-transparent overlay featuring white Traditional Chinese text asking a final question.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic dance music with a strong funk bassline and steady percussion begins. A prominent synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect emphasizes the visual of the car drifting. The spectral brightness is high, and the mix is clean and punchy. (2) A male narrator begins speaking in Traditional Chinese. His tone is casual and conversational, with a moderate speech rate and clear articulation. The music ducks slightly in volume to accommodate the voice while maintaining its upbeat rhythm. (3) A sharp 'click-clack' camera shutter sound effect marks a transition. The narrator's pitch drops slightly as he adopts a more confessional, storytelling tone, discussing the realities of managing employees. The music continues as a consistent rhythmic backdrop. (4) The audio transitions to a more analytical mode as the narrator discusses specific business figures and merchandise pricing. The vocal intensity is stable, and the acoustic environment sounds like a clean car cabin with minimal exterior noise interference. (5) A series of quick 'pop' sound effects coincide with text graphic appearing on screen. The narrator's voice remains dominant and authoritative. The music harmonic tension remains low, reinforcing the comedic/informative nature of the segment. (6) The video ends with a final rhetorical question from the narrator. The background music swells slightly before fading out into studio silence over the final black screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous and ironic narrative about a boss 'drawing a big pie' (making grand promises) to his employees. It uses the luxury of a Mercedes G-Class as a hook to ironically transition into a genuine promotion for branded merchandise (towels), calculating how many must be sold to actually afford the car.
